items.text: The artifact digest, code revision, training snapshot, feature version, owner, and approval are bound to one immutable release record.
Training and evaluation data use point-in-time feature values, with no future-information leakage.
Offline evaluation meets absolute quality floors and agreed bounds for critical population, region, and product slices.
Target-hardware tests prove latency, memory, throughput, schema compatibility, and feature freshness within the serving envelope.
The canary cohort is representative enough to reveal the important traffic, feature, and outcome slices before broader promotion.
Versioned service, drift, fairness, outcome, and fallback guardrails can pause promotion automatically.
The previous compatible artifact, feature contract, serving configuration, and rollback authority are ready for the two-minute recovery target.
Feature-cache misses and unavailable dependencies have a bounded, observable fallback, abstention, or human-review policy.
